name: Karim
source:
A mysterious biot the protagonist meets at the GL reparation and maintenance office. Karim's been transferred from one facility to another, unable to get anyone to determine the cause of this performance issues reported by his owner.

Likes: Other biots, dancing, tanning, driving flying cards, and massages
Dislikes: Small spaces, biot paste, wearing dirty clothes, rainy weather, humans

Age: ???
